summary: Reproduced Gemma4's quadratic dense image-attention metadata on the prepared base, then replaced it with compact per-request image spans. Triton evaluates causal-or-same-image directly in both extend kernels, and the spans are supplied only to sliding-attention layers. The implementation follows the still-open upstream candidate PR #33034, adapted to the newer prepared base.

tests.what_was_measured: Regression failed because compact image-span metadata was absent; the prepared implementation instead installed a dense custom mask. Raw output: reports/j-233fe0f883cd/raw/failing_before_unit.log

Compact metadata contents and size, sliding-only layer selection, mixed-batch indptr construction, and causal fallback for an image split across a chunk boundary. Two tests passed. Raw output: reports/j-233fe0f883cd/raw/unit_after.log

On gfx950, both two-stage and unified Triton extend kernels matched an independent PyTorch dense-attention reference for two requests, prefixes, multiple spans, a query-block-crossing span, and a span ending at the request boundary. Raw output: reports/j-233fe0f883cd/raw/gpu_image_span.log

The new image-span test and 10 other tests passed. Three pre-existing/general gfx950 expectations failed: generic large extend-attention tolerance, block-size expectation (_is_gfx95 classification), and one unified-vs-regular tolerance case. Raw output: reports/j-233fe0f883cd/raw/gpu_attention_full.log
All changed Python sources and tests compiled successfully. Raw output: reports/j-233fe0f883cd/raw/py_compile.log
No whitespace errors. Raw output: reports/j-233fe0f883cd/raw/diff_check.log

gpu_evidence: Executed both modified Triton extend-attention kernels and compared their numerical output with a PyTorch reference on the assigned single AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950, using torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. See reports/j-233fe0f883cd/raw/gpu_environment.log and gpu_image_span.log.
remaining_limitations: Gemma4 E4B model weights were not available, so no full-model semantic/quality or TTFT benchmark was performed.
The reported H20 and DGX Spark NVIDIA performance results were not reproduced on this AMD gfx950 host; the local GPU evidence is kernel-level numerical parity only.
The full pre-existing Triton attention test file has three unrelated/general gfx950 failures recorded in gpu_attention_full.log; the issue-specific image-span test passes.
Ruff and Black are not installed in the prepared interpreter; py_compile and git diff --check passed.
